@returns The handle of the window that is active now, or the one that was active last when your program has lost the focus. 0 if no window was made yet.
@gap There is no "none of ours is active" state: the answer is always the window of the program that was activated most recently, by the user or by [ActivateWindow](ActivateWindow).
